concept.title: Scenario 10 — Image placed inside a text box
concept.shortdesc: Consider a document where the author has placed an image inside a Word text box

conbody.p: Consider a document where the author has placed an image inside a Word text box to control positioning. Text boxes are floating objects and are not part of the main paragraph flow.

Result:The converter skips the Word text box content but retains the image placed inside the text box. The extracted image is mapped to a DITA <image> element, typically wrapped in a <fig> if it appears as a block image.
conbody.note: Do not place images inside Word text boxes. Although the image may be retained, any surrounding text box content can be lost during conversion.
